conclusion: FTShare is not accepted as production source B. The bounded qualification stopped because the batch response symbol set did not match the two requested canonical symbols. Independent-source lineage, market-data licensing, units, quotas and SLA also remain undocumented.

failure.message: FTShare batch symbols do not match the request

governance_blockers: The underlying stock candlestick data supplier is not disclosed, so independence from BaoStock and AKShare upstreams is unproven.
The MIT license covers the SDK source code but no market-data usage license was found.
No official response-unit, correction, quota or SLA contract was found for stock candlesticks.
Version 0.1.1 is not resolvable from the Python package index and the official GitHub Releases page has no usable release artifact.
